limitations: No runtime or network behavior was tested on Windows. Marker and per-subrequest retry are a hypothesis, not implemented or proven. They would not address 503s after Solr has begun processing and require an intermediary trust contract. Existing RouteException and communication-error retries remain unchanged. Baseline gate and exploratory Linux probe are separate jobs.
source_evidence: Solr server/etc/jetty-graceful.xml and test-framework JettySolrRunner install ordinary GracefulHandler; server/build.gradle disables Java compilation
Both HTTP transports currently discard headers before shared error classification; UpdateRequest iterator and StreamingUpdateRequest can be non-repeatable
CloudSolrClient currently retries whole requests for RequestNotSentException and RouteException 503, so neither is a safe marker for partially completed multi-shard requests
SOLR-18341 contains related unproven broader replay classification; do not equate idempotence with safe replay under arbitrary interleavings
summary: Narrowed newly added 503 retries to QUERY-typed requests after finding that UNSPECIFIED GenericSolrRequest can mutate data; added generic-write and marked-query tests. Proposed a distinct pre-handler shutdown rejection signal, retried only for a demonstrably repeatable failed LB subrequest.
